basic.explanation: Atoms are the basic building blocks of matter. They consist of a nucleus (protons and neutrons) and electrons orbiting it. Atoms of the same element have the same number of protons (atomic number).

intermediate.notes: Bohr's model of the atom and wave-particle duality. Quantum numbers: principal, azimuthal, magnetic, and spin.

pro.advanced_explanation: Schrodinger wave equation and orbital visualization.
